pages.text: What's more fearsome than a crocodile? An undead one! A perfect gift for necromancy enthusiasts! These undead crocodiles are born deadly hunters, capable of biting onto creatures and dragging them into the water for a devastating death roll.
Who's the next meat on the chopping block
Feeding your crocodile any kind of meat will heal it. The Necro Set also grants your undead crocodile additional regeneration.
